citation_rules.direct_source: cite the supplied source_handle and bibliographic identity; the local packet maps it to paper_id
citation_rules.review_reported_original: keep the reporting review in source metadata; cite the resolved original study normally, with equal substantive use and no mandatory weaker wording or repeated review label
citation_rules.scope: preserve the actual reported findings and conditions; full-text access is not a prerequisite for using a sufficient abstract or expert review account
